query: what idempotency key was recorded when a payment was blocked as a replayed duplicate charge?
notes: Three visually identical `duplicate charge blocked idempotency_key=... reason=...` lines exist (insufficient-funds and expired-card decoys plus the real replay), interleaved among a dozen ordinary `charge accepted` lines. At a ~10% budget only bm25 -- driven by the query's 'replayed' term, unique to the real line -- keeps it; recency, frequency, and llmlingua_style each keep one of the *other* two near-identical blocked-charge decoys instead. The txn and audit-ref atoms sit on separate lines and are force-kept regardless of selector.
